pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 35087-35100 (label lemma-make-finite-level, canonical tag 09F4): for a tower of discrete valuation rings with the bottom of mixed characteristic, weakly unramified first step, a primitive p-th root of unity on the middle ring and Galois top extension of degree p, there is a finite Galois extension of the bottom fraction field, totally ramified over the bottom ring, that either is a weak solution for the tower or makes the top extension one of finite level. The proof environment at source lines 35102-35140 immediately follows it and is its own proof: Kummer theory produces the element whose p-th root generates the top extension, the case where its order is prime to p is handled by building a totally ramified degree p extension and using weak unramifiedness going up along it, and the remaining case is reduced to a unit whose residue class either is not a p-th power, giving weak unramifiedness, or is one, in which case the equation is brought to the form y^p = 1 + pi b and exhibits finite level explicitly.
